name: data
label: File
help: The file to verify. It is hashed inside Make and only the hash is sent.

name: digest
label: Digest
help: Instead of a file: its SHA-256 as base64.

name: proof
label: Proof
help: Optional. A proof object, usually mapped from the Proof output of an earlier BitGraph module. Supply it to verify that exact proof rather than whatever the ledger currently holds. With a proof but no file, the result confirms the proof is genuine but cannot confirm which file it belongs to.

name: allowedMeasurements
label: Allowed Enclave Measurements
help: Advanced. When set, a proof signed by any other enclave build fails verification. Leave empty to accept any measurement the boundary has published.
